item.title: 48 hours to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 — hear directly from the people building what’s next
item.description: Less than 48 hours, TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 starts in San Francisco’s Moscone West. Save up to $100 on your pass before prices increase at the door, plus get 50% on a second pass. Or score other deals.

item.title: Anbernic's next dual-screen handheld has the perfect aspect ratio for 3DS games
item.description: The RG DDS's main display has a 5:3 aspect ratio while its bottom screen will be 4:3.

item.title: The iPhone clock app has an oddity not many people know about
item.description: Sure, you can set your iPhone's alarm to any time you choose. But there's a hidden limit to how far your choices will stretch, though most users won't reach it.

item.title: Steam Frame teardown reveals one problem with its future repairs
item.description: In an otherwise repairable device, the cooling fan is hard to reach.

item.title: Oscal Pilot 8 rugged phone review
item.description: Oscal's new rugged smartphone swaps MediaTek for Qualcomm, kept the price sensible, and has plenty of desirable features - all in a slim and light package.

item.title: « Les satellites fonctionnent, mais les soldats ne reçoivent plus rien » : la Russie exploite une faille de Starlink !
item.description: Sur le front ukrainien, le brouillage de Starlink par la Russie révèle un paradoxe : les liaisons entre satellites sont désormais optiques et quasi inbrouillables, mais la connexion finale avec l'utilisateur au sol reste tributaire des radiofréquences. Laurynas Mačiulis, P.-D.G. d'Astrolight,...
